about.title: About Me
about.lede: Hello! I’m Andrea Harkins (nee Maille), but feel free to call me Andy.
about.description:
I’m a Senior Front End Engineer && Technical Lead based in Toronto. Since 2019, I’ve worked in both brand and agency settings creating the dreamiest e-commerce experiences. I love the challenges that come with building brands in a digital landscape, and I value how each page view can create meaningful human experiences.

I build technical solutions that are flexible, scalable and performant, and I advocate for ethical practices and more accessible, inclusive environments wherever I go.

When I’m not coding, you can catch me planning my next travel adventure, working on a DIY project or diving into a new book.
